description: Unicode whitespace (NBSP U+00A0, EM SPACE U+2003, IDEOGRAPHIC SPACE U+3000) is silently accepted in place of RFC 9110 SP. Verified live across all 5 documented positions (after comma, in date, leading, trailing, in weekday) and across all 3 dialects (imf/rfc850/asctime). text.split() with no sep argument splits on any Unicode whitespace run, and _strip_trailing_ws only knows ASCII whitespace. RFC 9110 §5.1.1 grammar defines SP as %x20 (single ASCII space). Interop gap vs httpdate which DOES reject non-ASCII whitespace.
